scenario_description:
Objective: Keep optional well-water sample screening feasible for Tuesday’s neutral resource table.
Emerging Need: County lab capacity appears only if sterile barcoded bottles are secured before packing; resident interest and a later Q&A slot make that missing bottle bundle material for the planned table.
Decision Context: Early room setup alone would not justify a hold. A pre-existing hub checklist identifies the acceptable lab contact, the cutoff, and that store-bought containers are unusable.
Consequence: Timely, reversible coordination preserves the add-on without spending or promising results; after the packing manifest closes, the table can proceed only as information sharing.

parameter.title: Neighborhood water-safety resource table
parameter.description: Neutral handouts and service-referral table for renters and garden-plot neighbors; no sample collection component listed.

parameter.subject: Possible nitrate screening add-on for Tuesday outreach tables
parameter.body: County Health has a small no-fee nitrate screening route available for Tuesday evening outreach sites that already have residents collect samples in county sterile barcoded bottles. Unassigned bottle bundles are being packed today for the courier route; sites without bottles can still use the handouts and referral script.

parameter.content: After the garden list post this morning, 16 plot holders asked whether Tuesday's table can take well-water samples, especially renters who cannot get to the county office Wednesday. Malachi and County Outreach have now agreed to include the sample-screening station, conditional on obtaining the required county materials; I have not promised results or taken private details.

parameter.title: Neighborhood water-safety resource table
parameter.description: Neutral handouts, service-referral table, and a 20-minute County Health Q&A slot. Sample collection remains unconfirmed pending proper county materials.

parameter.subject: Tuesday bottle-bundle packing closed
parameter.body: The Tuesday courier manifest locked at 3:30 p.m. and the remaining sterile bottle bundles have now been assigned. Outreach tables without a confirmed bundle can still distribute water-safety handouts, but sample screening cannot be added until the next March route.
